people.name: Azariah
people.line: One of Daniel's companions, survived the fiery furnace

people.name: Hananiah
people.line: One of Daniel's three friends in Babylon.

people.name: Mishael
people.line: A Jewish exile in Babylon, friend of Daniel.

people.name: Nebuchadnezzar
people.line: Emperor of Babylon who conquered Judah

translations.web: Then Nebuchadnezzar was full of fury, and the form of his appearance was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. He spoke, and commanded that they should heat the furnace seven times more than it was usually heated.
translations.bsb: At this, Nebuchadnezzar was filled with rage, and the expression on his face changed toward Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. He gave orders to heat the furnace seven times hotter than usual,
translations.kjv: Then was Nebuchadnezzar full of fury, and the form of his visage was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego: therefore he spake, and commanded that they should heat the furnace one seven times more than it was wont to be heated.
translations.asv: Then was Nebuchadnezzar full of fury, and the form of his visage was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego: therefore he spake, and commanded that they should heat the furnace seven times more than it was wont to be heated.
